lsu.label: Industry football roster estimate
lsu.source: CBS Sports (Hummer/Talty, Aug 17, 2026) industry poll — LSU most expensive 2026 football roster

cites.source: CBS Sports — Hummer/Talty, Aug 17, 2026. LSU may be closer to $50M; several sources over $50M; most expensive 2026 football roster.
Sports Illustrated — Fischer, Aug 27, 2026. Close to $50M and well above $40M.
TigerRag — Horne. No public payroll sheet; figure is football’s share of institutional revenue-share plus third-party NIL, not a $50M university check.

lsu.notes: Modeled / survey range — not booked NIL and not House spent. Combines football’s share of institutional revenue-share plus third-party NIL; not a school filing and not a $50M university check. House cap remains ~$20.5M all sports. Do not subtract from capacity or leftover. The desk does not have a booked LSU House spent total. Leftover still only exists when House spent is booked.
